baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transferred Book and the selected recipients are stated before the repeated internal partition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Transfer of a knowledge-bearing Book creates one selected recipient body; only afterward does the construction distribute that body's members among three positions. Receipt therefore precedes demonstrated performance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies transgenerational transfer of knowledge or scripture and makes common reception the mechanism's first step.
Supplies the written corpus that can pass from predecessors to a later body.
Supplies deliberate selection of the recipient set before its internal differentiation.
Supplies a shared relation of serving obedience that contains all three later positions.

changed_reading.before: The verse first appears to reward three already formed moral classes with different outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The verse first constitutes one selected inheriting body, then diagnoses three positions arising inside that common entrustment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The self-wronger, the directed moderate, and the one moving ahead are all grammatically related to the same inherited Book.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Book supplies a binding norm. Relative to it, one member misplaces or withholds what is due from the self, one keeps a straight and measured course, and one advances through beneficial acts. The labels can therefore describe vectors of response rather than sealed castes.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an established norm against which the three responses become relationally legible.
Supplies misplacement in time or location as a functional account of the first response.
Supplies withholding a due right, here directed back toward the member's own self.
Fixes the affected object as the person's own concrete self rather than an abstract external victim.
Supplies straightness of route, making the middle position directed and stable rather than merely lukewarm.
Adds measured balance between excess and neglect to the middle course.
Supplies forward initiative and converts the third label into active movement.
Specifies beneficial good as the medium through which forward movement occurs.

changed_reading.before: The three nouns look like fixed identity labels arranged on a static ladder.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as three live orientations to one entrusted norm: self-defeating misplacement, measured direction, and beneficial advance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The selected set explicitly still contains a member who wrongs his own self.
baseline_models.mechanism: Selection extracts a set for a role, but the immediate internal contrast blocks equating selection with completed moral purity. The chosen status can mark vocation, custody, or opportunity while leaving response genuinely variable.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the expectation of filtered purity that the following self-wronger productively disrupts.
Supplies selection as an act of choosing, allowing role-selection to remain distinct from final certification.
Keeps a real failure inside the selected set by identifying a right withheld from the self.

changed_reading.before: Being selected appears synonymous with already being morally pure.
changed_reading.after: Selection establishes a charged role or opportunity whose recipients can still answer it badly, adequately, or exceptionally.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Forward movement is explicitly qualified by divine permission, followed by a deictic declaration of great excess or gift.
baseline_models.mechanism: The one ahead acts, but authorization opens the effective route; beneficial advance is therefore neither inert predestination nor autonomous merit. The final deictic can name the surplus bestowed in precedence, the whole differentiated inheritance, or both without forcing one scope.

activation_trace.role: Supplies real initiative and forward movement by the recipient.
Supplies authorization as the enabling condition under which initiative becomes effective.
Supplies an excess or remainder beyond what allocation or need alone would predict.
Supplies unowed benefaction, preventing the final greatness from becoming a wage mechanically earned.
Marks the deictically indicated arrangement as a matter of major consequence.

changed_reading.before: The permission sounds parenthetical and the great bounty sounds like a prize for the fastest class alone.
changed_reading.after: Permission is operationally constitutive, while the great surplus may encompass both enabled precedence and the larger gift of differentiated inheritance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context distributes created capacities and then contrasts what is opened with what is held. That gating sequence revises the triad from conduct alone into conduct operating under differentiated, divinely controlled availability.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the shared inherited resource as the focus-side object whose uptake varies.
Supplies deliberate configuration into differing created conditions rather than undifferentiated sameness.
Supplies expandable capacity, making degree and development part of the contextual field.
Supplies an opened access path through which a resource can become available.
Supplies the opposed operation of retaining or blocking, establishing a genuine gate on availability.

structural_cues: 35:1 presents visibly differentiated capacities before 35:2's balanced opening-and-holding antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies configured difference, increase, opening, and holding; I map that gate to differential activation of the inherited Book. A live alternative is that the opening concerns mercy generally and does not explain the three focus positions.

changed_reading.before: Each class appears to arise solely from an independently chosen quantity of deeds.
changed_reading.after: The classes can also register responses made under unequal but divinely gated capacities, without erasing responsibility for the response.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bad act can be cosmetically improved until its agent sees it as good, while guidance changes direction. The focus self-wronger can therefore fail at evaluation before failing at execution: inherited criterion is present, yet the self misreads its own work.

activation_trace.role: Supplies wrong placement as the focus-side failure now applied to moral perception.
Locates the failure in the self's intention and discernment, not only in outward injury.
Supplies active beautification that can alter how an act presents to its agent.
Keeps the underlying object genuinely bad despite its improved appearance.
Supplies inward judgment, where cosmetic presentation becomes a mistaken reading.
Supplies gentle direction toward the right route as the corrective counterpart to self-misreading.

structural_cues: 35:8 orders the sequence as bad work, beautification, seeing it as good, and then guidance or misguidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a corrupted perception sequence; I identify that sequence as one mechanism of wronging one's own self while holding a Book. The alternative is that 35:8 describes outsiders and only analogically illuminates the selected group.

changed_reading.before: The self-wronger is simply someone with a larger external tally of bad acts.
changed_reading.after: The self-wronger may be an heir whose evaluative apparatus has inverted, causing the inherited norm to be misapplied to his own conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good expression and sound action form a coupled upward process. This gives the focus advance through good things a conversion mechanism: inherited wording does not remain stored but becomes articulated, enacted, and raised.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the written starting material whose practical conversion is at issue.
Supplies forward movement that the context recasts as an upward word-and-work process.
Supplies intelligible utterance as the first active output rather than silent possession.
Supplies intentional practice that couples language to embodied response.
Specifies the practice as repairing rather than corrupting.
Supplies the vertical trajectory that changes generic precedence into ascent.
Supplies the lifting operation joining sound action to ascending expression.

structural_cues: 35:10 places good speech and sound action in one upward syntax rather than listing them as unrelated virtues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upward speech and lifting action; I treat them as the operational route by which a Book-heir moves ahead. The alternative is that 35:10 describes acceptance generally and does not specify the focus triad.

changed_reading.before: Advancing through good things means accumulating more items than the other heirs.
changed_reading.after: Advancing can mean successfully converting inherited language into a coupled ascending practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two bodies remain explicitly unequal, yet each yields nourishment while extraction, adornment, movement, and pursuit of surplus continue. This supplies a model in which real internal asymmetry need not make every non-leading member barren.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the joining medium that keeps unlike members inside one recipient body.
Supplies explicit non-equivalence, preventing the model from flattening the three positions.
Supplies extraction from hidden potential as an output available within unequal conditions.
Adds value-bearing adornment as a second kind of product beyond basic nourishment.
Supplies active passage through a resistant medium, preserving movement despite difference.
Makes surplus the pursued output of movement through the unequal field.

structural_cues: The antithetical pair in 35:12 is followed by a shared 'from each' clause rather than exclusive productivity from only one side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inequality with shared yield; I map the two-source ecology onto the three-member inheritance as a constraint against treating lower position as total sterility. The alternative is that the sea analogy should not be transferred to moral membership.

changed_reading.before: Only the foremost heir can produce value from the inherited Book.
changed_reading.after: The heirs can remain genuinely unequal while more than the leading position still yields real, differently scaled goods.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective inheritance does not pool moral effects: burdens cannot be shifted, and purification returns to the acting self. The three positions are therefore individually realized relations within a corporate trust, not inherited merit or guilt.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the corporate transgenerational trust whose moral effects must now be distinguished by person.
Supplies a heavy burden and the explicit impossibility of moving it from one bearer to another.
Supplies personal bearing of responsibility rather than transfer of moral load.
Supplies purification as an actual repair whose benefit returns to its agent.
Fixes the return point of purification as the same concrete self named in the focus failure.

structural_cues: 35:18 repeats bearer and burden before closing its purification clause with an explicit reflexive beneficiary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-transfer and reflexive benefit; I use these to separate a collectively inherited office from individually realized status. The alternative is that the focus classes are fixed eschatological groups even though their burdens remain individual.

changed_reading.before: Membership in the selected inheriting body might itself transfer collective merit to every member.
changed_reading.after: The office is shared, but each member personally realizes self-loss, measured fidelity, or advance; neither merit nor burden rides automatically on the inheritance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier communities receive warners and written corpora; the present revealed Book validates what stands before it. The focus inheritance thus becomes a relay of reception, preservation, testing, and confirmation rather than first possession of an isolated object.

activation_trace.role: Supplies succession in knowledge and scripture as the focus-side handoff.
Supplies a messenger-and-message link in the chain of prior reception.
Supplies successive communities as the social units through which transmission passes.
Supplies elapsed generations, giving inheritance an actual predecessor dimension.
Supplies earlier written books as concrete upstream material in the relay.
Repeats the written corpus before the focus inheritance and ties the object to prior delivery.
Supplies the present Book's revelatory arrival immediately before it is inherited.
Supplies fulfillment and confirmation as the operation joining present revelation to prior material.

structural_cues: 35:24-25 universalizes earlier warning and books, while 35:31 immediately precedes the focus with a backward-confirming relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earlier communities, messages, books, elapsed time, present revelation, and confirmation; I connect these into a custodial relay carried by the selected heirs. A live alternative is that inheritance names benefit received, not a duty to continue transmission.

changed_reading.before: The selected people newly possess a self-contained Book.
changed_reading.after: They occupy the current link in a transgenerational validating relay, and their three positions describe how that relay is carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible variation across fruits, rock bands, creatures, and people leads directly to knowledgeable servants whose recognition produces awe. Selection in the focus can therefore preserve differentiated human responses rather than bleaching the selected group into sameness.

activation_trace.role: Keeps deliberate selection as the focus-side operation now constrained by contextual diversity.
Supplies divergence into distinct routes and gives difference a directional rather than merely decorative force.
Supplies differentiated kinds in the immediately preceding natural display.
Supplies awe as a response generated within the field of knowledge.
Links knowledgeable response to the same serving population from which the focus heirs are selected.
Supplies disclosed understanding as one mechanism that differentiates response among servants.

structural_cues: The color-difference sequence of 35:27-28 narrows to servants, knowledge, and awe only four verses before the focus partition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated variation and then knowledgeable servants; I read the focus triad as a human response-spectrum continuous with that variation. The alternative is that natural diversity only demonstrates power and does not characterize the selected set.

changed_reading.before: Selection should make the recipients homogeneous, with the triad an awkward exception.
changed_reading.after: The triad can be the expected human variegation of a selected body, with knowledge and awe among the mechanisms that move response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation, established practice, and expenditure put the Book into circulation as a trade that does not go stagnant; full dues are then paid and an increment is added from surplus. Inheritance becomes working capital whose value appears through use, not an heirloom preserved untouched.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an uncontracted grant that functions as initial capital rather than a wage.
Supplies following recitation as the first circulation of the inherited corpus.
Identifies the same written object as the asset being actively read.
Supplies outward expenditure, preventing circulation from being reduced to verbal possession.
Supplies profit-seeking exchange as the explicit economic frame for active response.
Supplies the threatened stagnation-to-ruin that this particular trade escapes.
Supplies full settlement without deficit as the first return on circulation.
Adds growth beyond full settlement and creates an explicit surplus layer.
Names the increment as benefaction rather than a mechanically owed commercial return.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 forms an input-to-return sequence immediately before the confirming Book and its inheritance in 35:31-32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Book-use, spending, trade, non-stagnation, full payment, and added benefaction; I treat inheritance as entrusted capital activated by those practices. The alternative is that the economic language describes reward only and should not characterize the inherited object.

changed_reading.before: Inheriting the Book means possessing and preserving a prestigious object.
changed_reading.after: Inheriting the Book means putting a granted asset into recitative, ritual, and social circulation so that it yields full return plus unowed increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the selected heirs are partitioned, the next unit continues with an unqualified plural entering, being adorned, and settling in an abode explicitly attributed to benefaction. This keeps alive an inclusive reading in which internal inequality does not automatically split the heirs into different final destinations.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the nearest explicit plural body available as antecedent for the following entrants.
Supplies collective entry without internally restating or narrowing the three focus groups.
Supplies arrival and settled occupancy as the destination of the continuing plural.
Supplies durable residence, turning the destination into stable accommodation rather than a passing reward.
Attributes the settled destination to benefaction and links it back to the focus declaration.

structural_cues: 35:33 immediately resumes with plural verbal morphology and no overt subject reset after the threefold partition in 35:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate plural continuity, entry, settlement, and repeated benefaction; I take the selected heirs as the nearest antecedent. A materially live alternative is an implicit narrowing to the foremost or otherwise successful subset.

changed_reading.before: The three labels necessarily encode three separate final destinations.
changed_reading.after: They may encode unequal conditions within one inheriting population whose plural destination remains inclusive, though pronoun scope is not decisive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The world is actively held from displacement under patience and covering, then a received warning produces not the promised guidance but increased aversion. The focus triad can thus be a maintained but dynamic response system in which receipt may move a member forward, leave one measured, or amplify retreat.

activation_trace.role: Keeps effective forward response dependent on authorization rather than mere exposure.
Supplies active holding that maintains a system despite its tendency toward displacement.
Supplies movement away from an established state as the instability being restrained.
Supplies patient self-restraint as a reason mixed responses are not immediately terminated.
Supplies covering of fault and protection from its immediate effect within the maintained field.
Supplies the same warning stimulus before and after the response reversal.
Supplies the recipients' promised directional response to that stimulus.
Supplies amplification, showing that reception can intensify an existing orientation.
Supplies the actual movement away, reversing the promised direction toward guidance.

structural_cues: 35:42 repeats the arrival of the same warner on both sides of a promise-to-reversal sequence, immediately after 35:41's holding imagery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintenance, patience, fault-covering, one repeated stimulus, expected guidance, and actual amplified aversion; I treat the focus labels as dynamic trajectories within that held field. The alternative is that the three labels are final types and 35:42 concerns a separate population only.

changed_reading.before: Receiving revelation fixes a recipient's class immediately and uniformly.
changed_reading.after: Reception enters a maintained response system: the same disclosure can be activated toward advance or amplified into retreat, while patience leaves room for nonfinal states.

context_deltas.mechanism: A harmful scheme descends upon and encloses its own people within a stable recurring pattern. This supplies a causal account of the focus reflexive: wrongdoing may travel outward socially, yet its consequence curves back onto the self and its own affiliation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the initial deprivation of a right whose loss is borne by the wrongdoer.
Names the concrete self as the return point of the harmful process.
Supplies harm generated by the outward scheme rather than a merely private defect.
Supplies the return-and-enclosure operation by which harm settles around its source.
Locates the enclosing consequence in the scheme's own group of belonging.
Supplies a recurring path, making reflexive return a stable pattern rather than an accidental episode.

structural_cues: 35:43 repeats the harmful scheme around a verb of enclosure and then repeats the unchanging pattern language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward harm, enclosure of its own people, and recurrence; I use that directional loop to explain how focus wrongdoing is 'for' the self. The alternative is that the loop applies only to the specific schemers of 35:43.

changed_reading.before: Wronging oneself is a private inward fault with no social mechanism.
changed_reading.after: It can be a social action whose stable feedback loop encloses its source, making outward harm reflexively self-depriving.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare fire-related branch of inheritance and cross-maps it to an ecological stirring sequence. It remains anchored in the focus transfer verb and in 35:9's movement from stirring to revival, producing a real possession-versus-activation distinction. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not replace the ordinary inheritance sense or equate the three classes with literal combustion stages.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inheritance verb has an ember-stirring branch, while the inherited Book can visibly remain more or less activated in its recipients.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the unusual operation of stirring latent heat into flame and anchors the activation image in the focus verb.
Supplies active disturbance of a latent medium as the first contextual activation step.
Supplies directed driving, converting initial stirring into movement toward a target.
Supplies an inert receiving field that possesses potential but shows no active life.
Supplies revival of dry growth and completes the latent-to-active material sequence.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance is completed when the Book changes hands.
changed_reading.after: Inheritance can deliver latent material whose actual ignition or revival differs among recipients; possession and activation are separate events.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant and surprising because it places the writing-contract branch beside the owned-servant branch, then hears freedom under the same contextual root that surfaces as silk. The reading remains anchored in Book, servants, adornment, release, and settlement, but downstream prose must present it only as a social-legal resonance, never as a claim that the surface words lexically mean manumission or freedom here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly juxtaposes a Book with servants, and its inventories contain the paired images of an emancipation contract and owned service.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a written agreement through which an owned servant can move toward release.
Supplies the owned-servant relation that makes the contract image socially coherent.
Supplies the surface-appropriate fine garment at the adorned destination.
Supplies a freedom resonance under the same root, functioning only as a secondary release image.
Supplies removal of a restriction and lets the exploratory contract image terminate in release.

changed_reading.before: The Book is only a prestigious object handed to already defined servants.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, the Book can look like a written route by which owned servants are moved toward release, adornment, and settled belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates distributive and registry branches rather than the ordinary spiritual vocabulary. It remains focus-anchored in selection, the repeated internal partition, and declared surplus, and it clarifies why inclusion can precede unequal shares. Downstream prose should label it an allocative analogy, not infer a hidden legal apportionment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Selection, registry, repeated partition, and surplus all occur inside the focus's own lexical and grammatical field.

activation_trace.role: Supplies a specially reserved share designated before general division.
Supplies enrollment in a register and makes common inclusion administratively prior to allocation.
Supplies the remainder beyond division and gives the final declaration an allocative surplus texture.
Supplies a measured middle allocation between excess and deficiency.

changed_reading.before: Selection and the threefold division are unrelated devotional descriptions.
changed_reading.after: They can form an allocative image: a body is reserved and enrolled first, then internally differentiated, while surplus remains a gift beyond the shares.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the pursuit-and-escape edge of precedence. It remains anchored in the focus's forward mover and in 35:44's explicit denial that anything can evade divine reach; the contrast sharply qualifies agency. Downstream prose should present it as spatial counter-imagery, not redefine doing good as fleeing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus mover is ahead only through good things and by permission, while the later context denies autonomous outstripping of divine pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the edge case of getting beyond a pursuer and opens a chase geometry around precedence.
Constrains focus movement as authorized advance rather than self-created escape.
Supplies escape by outstripping pursuit precisely where the context denies that relation to any creature.
Supplies accumulated strength that still fails to create autonomous evasion.

changed_reading.before: The foremost member simply outruns everyone by personal strength.
changed_reading.after: True precedence is motion within divine permission and toward goods; the surrounding chase geometry blocks reading it as autonomous escape or superiority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it supplies a causal arrow from suspended seizure to the possibility of a legacy. It remains anchored in the focus inheritance and in 35:45's taking, leaving, and appointed delay. Downstream prose should qualify it as a temporal systems inference, not claim that 35:45 directly defines the focus inheritance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A later generation can inherit only if something and someone are allowed to remain across the interval separating predecessor from heir.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the predecessor-to-heir transfer that requires temporal survival of a remainder.
Supplies immediate seizure for wrongdoing as the counterfactual operation that would interrupt continuity.
Supplies a remaining trace after departure and makes persistence across time available to the inference.
Supplies what a predecessor leaves behind as the most direct branch bridge to inherited material.
Supplies the deferred time boundary that permits continuity before final reckoning.

changed_reading.before: The Book's inheritance is a timeless transfer unrelated to divine forbearance.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory systems reading, delayed seizure creates the temporal remainder through which a legacy and a later inheriting body can exist at all.

strongest_changes: The selected heirs remain one recipient body, while the context turns their three labels into dynamic and individually accountable response positions rather than inherited merit.
Earlier books, present confirmation, recitation, expenditure, non-stagnating trade, full settlement, and added benefaction make inheritance a transgenerational working relay.
Immediate plural continuation into entry and settled benefaction keeps an inclusive destination for the internally unequal heirs genuinely live.
Opening and holding, guidance and amplified aversion, and explicit permission make response effective through a maintained and gated system rather than autonomous capacity alone.
summary.what_was_special: Rare but anchored branches generated several non-collapsible readings: inheritance as latent ignition, Book-and-servants as a contained manumission resonance, selection as reserved allocation, precedence constrained by failed escape, and divine delay as the temporal condition for legacy. These remain exploratory alongside the stronger custodial, perceptual, economic, and inclusive models.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of the final deictic can be the foremost advance, the whole threefold inheritance, or both.
The plural subject after the focus most naturally continues the selected heirs, but an implicit narrowing to a successful subset remains possible.
The three positions may be dynamic trajectories, stable character types, or context-dependent mixtures of both.
The material and social outliers are branch activations and causal analogies, not replacements for the surface lexical senses.
